Bid Summary.value: The State of Maryland Treasurer's Office issued PORFP #E20P4600040 for Dell laptops and docks, with proposals due by 06/10/2024. The solicitation calls for 30 Dell Latitude 5550 laptops (Model CC7802) and 30 Dell Thunderbolt 4 Dock – WD22TB4, to be delivered within 45 days of award. All laptops must be Microsoft Copilot ready, ENERGY STAR certified, and covered by a three‑year limited hardware warranty with an extended warranty provision.
